messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — ACME (AC-9921) trial showing a 62% drop in active seats and 2 missed onboarding sessions last week. Possible downgrade at renewal if we don't act :warning:
ajay_csm: Can you drop the last-7d usage snapshot and carrier? also who owns the account AM-wise?
maria_cs: Last-7d snapshot: peak seats 48 -> now 18; feature X p95 latency up 80% on their region. AM is @oliver_am. I suspect the onboarding emails never arrived.
kevin_pm: Looks like our outbound webhook to SendGrid errored Sat night — stack trace in logs: 
```
2026-03-19T02:41:12Z ERROR sendgrid-webhook: 502 Bad Gateway
RequestId: b12f42
```
I pushed a retry hotfix, but accounts that missed that window probably didn't get the 1st-run invite.
sophia_support: @maria_cs @oliver_am recommending targeted enablement: 1) schedule a 30m live session w/ onboarding engineer; 2) one-click activation walkthrough; 3) 2-week power-user challenge with weekly check-ins. Offer a 2-week extension credit if they commit to the session :+1:
ajay_csm: Love that. Also propose we pre-fill a short survey for feedback during the session — capture friction points (email deliverability, initial model quality, SSO). Template:
```
1) How easy was it to get started? (1-5)
2) Which feature blocked you? (free text)
3) Would a live session help? (yes/no)
```
maria_cs: Outreach draft to send now (short):
"Hi {{first_name}} — noticed a hiccup during your trial. Can we book a 30-minute enablement to get you unblocked? We'll cover setup + a quick walkthrough and offer a 2-week extension if that helps. Available slots: [link]. — Maria, CSM"
oliver_am: I'll reach out to their primary user and book for tomorrow morning. If they push back, escalate to me and we'll offer a targeted credit and a prioritized onboarding slot.
eng-ops-bot: Incident #3321: SendGrid webhook failures 02:40-03:10 UTC — retry hotfix deployed 03:05 UTC. Monitoring green.
maria_cs: Playbook (short actionable steps):
- Triage: confirm missed onboarding emails + share snapshot (maria_cs)
- Outreach: send short invite + offer 2-week extension (maria_cs)
- Enablement: 30m session + survey (sophia_support)
- Escalation: AM to offer credit if no-show or dissatisfaction (oliver_am)
- Follow-up: check usage 3 days after session, close or escalate after 5 days (ajay_csm)
ajay_csm: Assigning tasks in Asana now — I'll include session slot links and the survey form. If we don't hear back in 5 business days mark as 'at-risk - no response' and route to retention specialist.
maria_cs: Thanks everyone. I'll send the outreach and post session notes here. :pray:
oliver_am: Thx — please @me for any major pushback. We'll aim to convert this trial. :rocket:
